prompt_text: Who is the best roofing company in Dallas for a roof replacement?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: I can’t name a single objectively “best” roofer for all situations — the right company depends on your location in the Dallas area, roof type, budget, whether the job involves an insurance claim, and what warranty/finish you want. I can, however, help you find and vet the best roofer for your specific needs.

How to pick the best roofing company in Dallas
- Check credentials
  - Proof of insurance (liability + workers’ comp) and a local business address.
  - Manufacturer certifications (GAF Master Elite, CertainTeed Select ShingleMaster, Owens Corning Preferred, etc.).
  - Local licenses/registrations required by city or county.
- Reputation and references
  - Read recent reviews on Google, Yelp, Nextdoor, BBB and Angi/HomeAdvisor.
  - Ask for references for similar jobs (same material and scope) and follow up.
- Written estimate and contract
  - Get at least 3 written, line-item estimates (materials, labor, permits, cleanup).
  - Contract should include start/end dates, materials brands and specs, payment schedule, and cleanup/lien waiver terms.
- Warranty and workmanship
  - Manufacturer shingle warranty + contractor’s workmanship warranty (ask how long and what it covers).
- Price vs value
  - Cheapest is not best. Look for transparent pricing and quality materials.
- Red flags
  - Door-to-door storm-chasers, high-pressure sales, only cash payments, very large upfront deposit, no physical address or no written contract.

Questions to ask a roofer
- Are you licensed/registered in my city? Can I see proof of insurance?
- Are you a certified installer for the shingle brand I want?
- Can you provide at least 3 local references for recent roof replacements?
- What is included in the estimate? (tear-off, underlayment type, ventilation, flashing, disposal)
- What warranties do you provide (materials and workmanship)?
- Who pulls permits and handles inspections?
- How do you handle insurance claims if I’m filing one?

Next steps I can do for you
- If you give your Dallas ZIP code, roof type (asphalt shingle, metal, tile), and whether you’re using insurance, I can suggest how to find the top-rated local companies and draft a comparison checklist.
- I can also draft an email/message to send to contractors or a script for phone calls/meetings.

Tell me your ZIP code and a couple of preferences (roof material, budget range, insurance claim?), and I’ll help narrow it down.
